title: AWKUM Offers Internships to Students of Government Girls Degree College, Sheikh Maltoon, Mardan
text:
In line with the Honorable Vice Chancellor, Prof. Dr. Jamil Ahmad's vision of fostering inter-institutional collaboration, the University Advancement & Career Development Centre (UA&CDC), Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan (AWKUM), facilitated the placement of 35 students from Government Girls Degree College Sheikh Maltoon, Mardan, as interns in various research laboratories of the University. These students have been facilitated in the newly established laboratory, the Mardan Research Laboratory (MRL), in the Departments of Botany and Biochemistry, as well as in various sections of the Department of Chemistry.
The UA&CDC team, including Dr. Muhammad Bilal, Director and Mr. Usman Shamroz, Assistant Director, has briefed the students on the internship policy and rules and regulations of the university. The students were also briefed on punctuality and the internship's progress.

During the 6 to 8-week internship, students will gain hands-on experience in laboratory techniques, research methodologies, scientific equipment handling, and laboratory safety practices. The program aims to enhance their practical skills, professional confidence, and career readiness by providing exposure to real-world research and laboratory environments.
This initiative reflects AWKUM’s commitment to promoting experiential learning and strengthening academic and professional collaboration with local and regional institutions.
